messages:
Anna (Partner Ops): Quick heads-up — finance needs the finalized QBR scorecards + MDF asks by EOD Friday. Putting a lightweight checklist here so we don't lose anything.
Samir K: Which partners are in scope for the QBR pack? marketplace, HW, and SI integrations?
Olivia M: Yes — cloud marketplace (top 12), two HW partners (NimbleCore, VoltaScale) and 3 SI pilots.
Liam S: Do we have a hard cap for total MDF this quarter or is it flexible?
Maya R: Finance approved a runway but wants per-tier ceilings. Proposed: Tier A max $300k, Tier B $90k, Tier C $25k.
Anna (Partner Ops): Putting the ask to partners will need justification lines in the scorecards (pipeline, co-sell motions, enablement plan). Use this mini-template: 
```
- Pipeline (3mo forecast): $xxx
- Expected co-sell motions: list
- GTM assets: enablement deck, demo, case study
- Commitment: joint events, partner engineering time
```
Samir K: I'll populate NimbleCore + VoltaScale scorecards. Olivia can you own marketplace templates?
Olivia M: On it. I'll also surface the marketplace usage metrics and conversion rate for the last 6 weeks. :eyes:
Liam S: For the SI pilots — need a short ROI blurb per SI (2 lines). Who's responsible for stitching customer success feedback?
Maya R: I'll pull the CS notes and add customer-level traction bullets.
Anna (Partner Ops): FYI — announce-bot pushed an updated QBR deck template this morning (link in #announcements). Please use that header.
announce-bot: QBR deck template v3 uploaded: https://docs.google.com/d/XXXX (auto-notice)
Samir K: Small ask on MDF math — can we break out spend into marketing vs. co-fund engineering hours? Finance prefers both line items.
Anna (Partner Ops): Yes. Suggest we show both: Marketing spend (events/content) + Technical enablement (engineer hours @ $X/hr). Include a conservative and stretch ask.
Olivia M: I'll draft the marketplace ask with conservative/stretch and share the sheet: https://docs.google.com/sheets/d/ABCD (comments open).
Liam S: If anyone needs a quick review before I submit to finance, ping me. I can do a 15-min slot tomorrow 11:30–11:45.
Maya R: Added a short partner-tier rationale note to the sheet. One lift: reclassify one partner from B to A based on new ARR commit — flagged in comments.
Anna (Partner Ops): Good. Two last checks: 1) make sure scorecards include target KPIs (rev influenced, pipeline, enablement sessions) and 2) add sign-off owner (Partner AM). I'll collate and send to finance Friday AM. :thumbsup:
Samir K: Copy. Will finish NimbleCore by noon tomorrow.
Olivia M: Marketplace draft by EOD today.
Liam S: SI ROI blurbs ready by tomorrow morning.
Maya R: CS traction compiled by tomorrow.
Anna (Partner Ops): Thanks team — this will keep the QBR pack tidy. If any blockers DM me.
